named_in: manuscript/FINAL.md 2.1 Truth maintenance and dependency repair
named_as: Doyle's Truth Maintenance System records justifications and supports dependency-directed revision
verdict_reason: Four independent corroborations of the same identifiers, but the article's own title page was not read, so this is not VERIFIED. (1) A BibTeX record from search gives 12(3):231-272 with DOI 10.1016/0004-3702(79)90008-0. (2) The ScienceDirect PII 0004370279900080 structurally encodes that same DOI -- a check computed here, not quoted. (3) A scan of the Ginsberg reprint collection carries a handwritten annotation reading 'Doyle, Jon (1979), A Truth Maintenance System, Artificial Intelligence 12: 231-272', which is an annotation and not a publisher statement. (4) That reprint exists in 'Readings in Nonmonotonic Reasoning', ed. M. L. Ginsberg, Morgan Kaufmann, 1987. The retrieved PDF is an image scan with no text layer, so extraction could not confirm the article header.
promotion_requires: retrieve the AIJ article (or a text-bearing scan of its first page) and read title, author, volume and page range off it
p6_delta: P6 explicitly does not claim selective repair; it asks what counts as a preservable downstream object when that object is a scientific certificate rather than a computation. This is the parent for the dependency-directed revision half.
